title: 4/22-6/12: heartbeat_watchdog wrote RUNNING every 60 s regardless of progress, so a wedged prediction cascade would have looked healthy with no alert (audit H5)
tier_reason: a wedge would silently lose the day's delivery with no page (liveness + alerting); no firing evidenced; B -> A: the fix is alert-only, so a detected wedge still loses the delivery unless the operator acts

contract.text: A RUNNING heartbeat certifies progress: a cascade stalled past the stall threshold is reported (stalled -> check_heartbeat -> Healthchecks /fail) while systemd watchdog pings continue.

mechanism.text: heartbeat_watchdog's pulse thread wrote state=RUNNING and sent sd_notify every 60 s based only on its own thread being alive, around the whole prediction cascade (incl. network)

the consumers had no stalled state: scripts/check_heartbeat.py and heartbeat.is_heartbeat_fresh scored any fresh RUNNING heartbeat healthy, and the */5 Healthchecks ping is unconditional, so nothing paged

residual.text: Phase 1 is alert-only: a detected stall pages (~20 min worst case) but nothing recovers the cascade; auto-restart and per-stage thresholds were deferred to a Phase 2 gated on the durations dataset
residual.source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-11-h5b-truthful-heartbeat-design.md 'Out of scope (Phase 2, gated on the jsonl dataset)'

watchdog.trigger: the heartbeat is stalled (or RUNNING with a stage age past the stall threshold) for > 15 min, or a game day reaches the earliest candidate's first pitch - 5 with no completed lineup-check cascade
watchdog.recovery_assertion: a completed cascade (durations row ok/ok_after_stall) and a delivered pick or recorded skip before the cutoff

evidence.locator: docs/audit/2026-06-09-fable5-full-audit.md 'Health & alerting' [P1] 'Wedged-but-pinging scheduler fools the external monitor' (f5de8ee)
evidence.what: a hang inside the cascade leaves check_heartbeat seeing a fresh RUNNING heartbeat forever, systemd fed, no pick, EOD never runs, the */5 hc-ping unconditional: total silence
the pulse 'certifies alive and running based on nothing but its own thread being alive' (wedged-but-pinging); network hangs are bounded, the in-process local tier is not
introduced heartbeat_watchdog (keep the heartbeat fresh during long predictions)
